items.title: The Next AI Chips Will Run on Light
items.summary: In episode 1045 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Ben Hein, CEO at Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, the current limitations of AI due to data transfer speeds and how future AI chips will leverage silicon photonics and light technology to overcome these bottlenecks. This innovation will enable faster data transmission and more real-time interactions with AI models, moving beyond traditional compute scaling. The shift towards three-dimensional integration and photonics is set to revolutionize AI performance.
